summary.name: Responsively App
summary.one_liner: Responsively is a free, open-source desktop browser for web developers that shows a site across many device sizes at once for responsive design testing.
keywords: test website on multiple screen sizes
use_cases: Checking a website's layout across phone, tablet and desktop sizes at once
Replicating clicks and scrolls across several device previews
Inspecting page elements across all devices simultaneously
Taking full page screenshots of a site on many devices
Saving favourite device combinations for repeated testing
summary.what_it_does: Responsively displays a web page side-by-side across many device viewports at once, so developers do not need to resize a single browser window. Interactions such as clicks, scrolls and navigation in one device are mirrored to all devices in real time. Users can save device combinations as Preview Suits and add custom device profiles to a built-in collection. A Unified Inspector (Cmd/Ctrl + I) shows element details across all devices, and one-click screenshots capture full pages on every device. The page also says it includes basic browser features such as cookie management, local storage, session storage and bookmarks.
notable: Mirrors clicks, scrolls and navigation across all device previews in real time
Unified Inspector shows element details across all devices at once
Free and open source, with about 25,497 GitHub stars per the page
caveats: The FAQ asks whether it renders the same as real devices or replaces them, but the page text provided does not state the answers
Platform list is not explicitly named on the page; desktop OS support is inferred only from the awesome-mac listing context
